summary: The ERP system allows for the creation of segments to represent different organizational units such as a main store or branches of an institute. Each branch or distinct operational unit requires a separate segment. Inventory masters, transactions, and reports are managed separately for each segment.
business_rules: To maintain a main store, a segment must be created.
To manage an institute with multiple branches, each branch must have its own segment within the same system panel.
important_notes: Inventory masters, transactions, and reports will be managed separately for each defined segment.
questions: How do I set up different branches for my institute in the ERP system?
What is the purpose of segments in the ERP system?
Can I manage inventory separately for each branch or store?
